provenance: Decoded by this project's own port of the algorithm described in references/snes.md, then checked by hand against the instruction at the decoded address in Super Mario World (USA), SHA-1 6b47bb75d16514b6a476aa0c73a683a2a4c18765. Codes come from a public list; descriptions are ours. The independent letter check is the manual snes9x run in docs/evals/snes-letters.md.

vectors.note: stops the life decrement (DEC becomes LDA)
changes the same life-decrement opcode to another instruction
changes the coin-limit compare immediate to $01
turns the timer decrement into a load
changes one byte in the player-hit path
changes a load immediate near the Start-button check
changes the coin-limit compare immediate (50 coins)
